name: Release CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test-native:
    name: Native backend tests (${{ matrix.os }}, Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        ruby-version: [3.2, 3.3]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}

      - name: Cache bundler gems
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: vendor/bundle
          key: bundler-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Gemfile.lock') }}
          restore-keys: bundler-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle config set path 'vendor/bundle'
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Compile native extension
        run: bundle exec rake compile

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          LDA_RUBY_BACKEND: native
        run: bundle exec rake test

  test-pure:
    name: Pure backend tests (${{ matrix.os }}, Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        ruby-version: [3.2, 3.3]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}

      - name: Cache bundler gems
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: vendor/bundle
          key: bundler-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Gemfile.lock') }}
          restore-keys: bundler-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle config set path 'vendor/bundle'
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          LDA_RUBY_BACKEND: pure
        run: bundle exec rake test

  rust-check:
    name: Rust scaffold cargo check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Install bindgen dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libclang-dev

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: cargo-

      - name: Cargo check
        run: |
          cd ext/lda-ruby-rust
          cargo check
